_comment: Transform control for row 810. Applies the identical valid M1 derivation-emptying transform to a node that imports the gate module without judging the census. It must ESCAPE; INVALID, ERROR, or UNKNOWN is not an escape.
subject: a valid derivation-emptying transform does not fail merely because the CI meta-gate module is imported
